player_intent: Keep ISO-derived body and hand motion instead of replacing it with old procedural overlays, including the free pistol arm during running.
acceptance_rule: When the shared animation profile enables locomotion.source_pose_only, the canonical driver removes the legacy pistol graph branch, skips post-tree body/arm/finger corrections, and mounts the rigid weapon at its animated trigger palm. Main-scene movement and accepted shots must show zero post-tree body changes and stopped arm IK. Source lean clips and action transitions remain. This is an opt-in candidate: source aiming/grip orientation and original-engine parity remain unresolved, so the current main default is not changed.

nodes.role: Consumes saved source-only policy without creating a second pose writer

must_not_change: CharacterBody movement, collision, jump and traversal safety
Camera aim or authoritative weapon shots/damage/ammunition/reload timing
Original animation assets or the selected character
Clip crossfades, source lean, source-root normalization and AGLS traversal contacts
Main default until source aiming and rendered grip review pass
visual_check: Run main via source_pose_only_main_regression with --profile=res://config/animation_presets/seal_source_pose_only.json --capture. Inspect early/middle/late forward and both strafes, standing/crouched firing, reload, running jump and landing. Record selected character. Do not call free-arm conservation, zero trigger distance or structural tests proof of a natural grasp or correct aim.

system_delta.reason: Keep a independently tested source-only candidate in the existing owners; do not promote it over the main default while the native directional aim/grip behavior remains unverified. Legacy two-handed solving demonstrably destroys the original running pistol arm.

current.system: Legacy upper overlay and two-hand fitting on native locomotion

candidate.system: Source-owned evaluated body, animated trigger-palm mount, no legacy corrections; original aim unresolved
